collection.name: Minecraft
collection.description: Minecraft game servers, modded runtimes and network proxies
collection.author: Midnight Team

shard.name: Paper
shard.description: High-performance fork of Spigot aiming to fix gameplay and mechanics inconsistencies as well as to drastically improve performance.
shard.author: PaperMC & Midnight Team
shard.installScript:
#!/bin/bash
# PaperMC Server Installation Script for Midnight Panel
set -e
apk add --no-cache curl jq

cd /mnt/server

if [ -z "${MINECRAFT_VERSION}" ] || [ "${MINECRAFT_VERSION}" == "latest" ]; then
    echo "Resolving latest PaperMC version..."
    MINECRAFT_VERSION=$(curl -s https://api.papermc.io/v2/projects/paper | jq -r '.versions[-1]')
fi

echo "Target Minecraft version: ${MINECRAFT_VERSION}"

if [ -z "${BUILD_NUMBER}" ] || [ "${BUILD_NUMBER}" == "latest" ]; then
    echo "Resolving latest build number for ${MINECRAFT_VERSION}..."
    BUILD_NUMBER=$(curl -s https://api.papermc.io/v2/projects/paper/versions/${MINECRAFT_VERSION}/builds | jq -r '.builds | map(select(.channel == "default")) | .[-1].build')
fi

echo "Target build number: ${BUILD_NUMBER}"
JAR_NAME="paper-${MINECRAFT_VERSION}-${BUILD_NUMBER}.jar"
DOWNLOAD_URL="https://api.papermc.io/v2/projects/paper/versions/${MINECRAFT_VERSION}/builds/${BUILD_NUMBER}/downloads/${JAR_NAME}"

echo "Downloading PaperMC from ${DOWNLOAD_URL}..."
curl -o "${SERVER_JARFILE}" -fSL "${DOWNLOAD_URL}"

echo "Writing eula.txt..."
echo "eula=true" > eula.txt

echo "Paper installation completed successfully!"

variables.name: Server Jar File
variables.description: The name of the executable jar file to run the Paper server.

variables.name: Minecraft Version
variables.description: The Minecraft version to install, e.g. 1.21.4, 1.20.4 or 'latest'.

variables.name: Build Number
variables.description: Paper build number or 'latest' for the newest stable release.
